reasons.plausibility: It aligns well with established principles of defect and impurity scattering in metals and alloys, making it scientifically sound and convincing.
reasons.testability: The proposed experiment directly compares predicted and measured conductivity under controlled oxygen levels and temperatures, providing a clear criterion to falsify the hypothesis if the predictive approach does not outperform the perfect-crystal model.
reasons.usefulness: Incorporating real defect and impurity effects is highly relevant to improving the accuracy of property predictions for high-entropy alloys, making this approach valuable to researchers seeking deeper insights and more reliable design models.
